comment: The oldest hc Collie works with: the one it is verified against, each release carries and doctor's fix installs. A newer hc passes and is never downgraded. To bump: set version and every target's sha256 from https://releases.herdr.dev/core/<version>/manifest.json, copy that release's released.openrpc.json, or what its `hc schema` prints where it has none, to hc.openrpc.json, then pass the contract test and `bun run probe:hc`.
